name: What maintenance is required for a hardwood deck?
description: Hardwood decks need regular cleaning and periodic re-sealing or oiling to protect against UV damage and moisture.

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for a hardwood deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hardwood decks require periodic maintenance to preserve their appearance and structural integrity. This typically includes regular cleaning to remove dirt and debris, and occasional sanding and re-sealing or oiling to protect the wood from UV damage and moisture. The frequency of re-sealing depends on the type of hardwood and its exposure to the elements in your specific location, such as a sunny backyard in Fremont or a shaded area in Berkeley. Neglecting maintenance can lead to fading, splintering, and reduced lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hardwood decks need regular cleaning and periodic re-sealing or oiling to protect against UV damage and moisture.
